items.description: Wizard set leggings, from Iron's Spellbooks. Dye it like leather armor to recolour the cloth parts (purple when undyed).
items.how_to_get: Rename a leather leggings to "Wizard Leggings" in an anvil (exact spelling and capitals).
items.stacking: Armor does not stack.

behaviour.other_players: Everyone sees the same piece.
behaviour.item_frame: 3D piece. Its name tag is hidden in the frame. Taken back out, it keeps its model but no longer stacks with freshly renamed copies.
behaviour.worn: The set's look painted onto the normal armor shape (flat: no capes or extra 3D parts).
behaviour.note: The worn look appears about a second after you put it on (the Dravengrad datapack sets it). It protects like leather armor.
